description: This file defines the 'ECUEditorMenuBar' class, which constructs and manages the menu bar UI for the ECU Editor application. It includes menu items for editing, view options, help, and other functionalities such as refresh, compare images, and ECU properties. The class handles user actions through action listeners, manages enabling/disabling menu items based on context, and provides functions for saving images and managing files.

classes.name: ECUEditorMenuBar
classes.description: A menu bar component for the ECU Editor application, providing menus for editing settings, viewing properties, image conversion, and help.

methods.name: updateMenu
methods.description: Updates the state and enabled/disabled status of menu items based on current application context.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles user actions on menu items, triggering corresponding functionalities such as opening dialogs, changing user level, or displaying information.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves the currently selected ROM image to a file chosen by the user.

methods.name: getImageOutputFile
methods.description: Displays a file save dialog and returns the selected file for saving image data.

methods.name: writeImage
methods.description: Writes the byte array data to the specified file.

methods.name: getRepositoryOutputDir
methods.description: Displays a directory chooser dialog for selecting a repository directory.

methods.name: saveAsRepository
methods.description: Saves multiple tables to files within a selected repository directory.

methods.name: increaseRomSize
methods.description: Attempts to increase the size of the current ROM image if valid.

methods.name: decreaseRomSize
methods.description: Attempts to decrease the size of the current ROM image if valid.

methods.name: getLastSelectedRomFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of the last selected ROM for display purposes.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Returns the current application settings object.
